columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Tool-call approvals need exact decision-to-action binding
columns.title_zh: 工具调用审批需要精确的决定—动作绑定
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260816-005 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It is the strongest bounded Digital Employee object in the run-date pool because it directly binds an authorization decision to the exact concrete tool call that is later executed. That creates a specific governance question about how a digital employee preserves approval identity across execution without broadening, substituting or replaying authority onto another action. Step-scoped configuration freezing is also strong, but exact approval-to-action binding is the more direct responsibility and authorization boundary.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260816-005，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它是运行日信号池中最强的有界数字员工对象，因为它把授权决定直接绑定到随后真正执行的具体工具调用，形成一个明确治理问题：数字员工如何在执行过程中保持审批身份，不把权限扩大、替换或重放到另一个动作上。活动轮次配置冻结同样重要，但精确的审批—动作绑定更直接触及岗位责任与授权边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the approval-decision data model, exact tool-call identity binding, where the decision is looked up and enforced, behavior across resume/retry/replay, denial and stale-decision handling, persistence boundaries and tests. Separate the demonstrated SDK fix from any broader claim of end-to-end authorization safety.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查审批决定的数据模型、具体工具调用身份如何绑定、决定在哪里被查找和执行、恢复/重试/重放时的行为、拒绝与陈旧决定处理、持久化边界以及测试；必须把 SDK 已证明的修复与“端到端授权安全”这一更广泛主张分开。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Reserved execution identities need pre-materialization metadata ownership and cleanup semantics
columns.title_zh: 预留执行身份需要实例化前元数据所有权与清理语义
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260816-001 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It exposes a bounded architecture for work that has an identity before its runtime object exists: the host can stage metadata against a reserved thread id, merge it on successful materialization, and clean it up if materialization never occurs. That supports a concrete architecture question about ownership, reconciliation and orphan cleanup across the boundary between reservation and execution. MultiProvider failure cleanup is valuable, but it is narrower than this identity-before-materialization state transition.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260816-001，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它暴露了一种有界架构：工作在真正的运行对象创建之前就已经拥有身份；宿主可以针对预留 Thread ID 暂存元数据，在成功实例化时合并，如果始终没有实例化则清理。由此形成具体架构问题：从“预留”跨越到“执行”的边界上，状态所有权、对账与孤儿清理应如何定义。MultiProvider 失败清理同样有价值，但其状态转换范围窄于这种“先有身份、后有运行对象”的机制。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how reserved identities are created, which metadata may be staged, ownership and overwrite rules, first-materialization merge ordering, failure and abandonment cleanup, concurrency behavior, persistence boundaries and tests. Do not infer a general durable-work protocol beyond the demonstrated Codex thread mechanism.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查预留身份如何创建、哪些元数据可以暂存、所有权与覆盖规则、首次实例化时的合并顺序、失败与放弃清理、并发行为、持久化边界以及测试；不得把 Codex Thread 已证明的机制直接泛化为通用持久工作协议。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agent SDK configuration overrides need deterministic precedence across raw, managed, and thread settings
columns.title_zh: Agent SDK 配置覆盖需要在原始、托管与线程设置之间具备确定性优先级
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260816-008 with Skill 02 score 45/50. It provides a concrete configuration-composition mechanism: ordered raw CLI overrides can represent TOML structures that SDK convenience fields cannot express, while precedence remains explicit relative to SDK-managed and thread-specific settings. That yields a testable engineering question about preserving deterministic policy and permission configuration across multiple configuration layers. Reasoning replay is also important, but the current signal is less explicit about its concrete state model and therefore ranks lower for Queue selection.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260816-008，Skill 02 评分 45/50。它提供了一个具体的配置组合机制：有序原始 CLI Override 可以表达 SDK 便捷字段无法表示的 TOML 结构，同时与 SDK 管理设置、Thread 级设置之间保持明确优先级。这形成可测试的工程问题：多层配置叠加时，如何保持策略和权限配置的确定性。推理重放同样重要，但当前 Signal 对其具体状态模型描述较少，因此本轮 Queue 排名更低。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact precedence order, parsing and serialization of raw overrides, conflict behavior with SDK-managed and thread settings, literal-path permission-map handling, duplicate keys, malformed values, security-sensitive configuration cases and tests. Do not treat deterministic precedence as proof that every configuration combination is safe.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查精确优先级顺序、原始 Override 的解析与序列化、与 SDK 管理设置和 Thread 设置冲突时的行为、字面路径权限映射处理、重复键、非法值、安全敏感配置场景以及测试；不得把“优先级确定”直接等同于“所有配置组合都安全”。
